Behavior.RangersGuile_CannotTargetOppone.reason: Oracle permits only a creature you control. With only an opposing Grizzly Bears present, EVENT_CAN_CAST incorrectly returns true: card_rangers_guile passes ANYBODY as the allowed controller to vanilla_instant_pump. Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.

Behavior.MysticalTutor_SearchEligibleCar.reason: Oracle puts the selected card on top after shuffling; it must not enter the hand. The shared put_on_top_of_deck wrapper passes a card slot to the core real_put_on_top_of_deck helper, which expects an internal card ID. The selected card stays in hand and a different card enters the library. Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.

Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.

Behavior.PitFight_RequiresAnotherCreatur.reason: Oracle requires another distinct target creature. With only one friendly Grizzly Bears present, EVENT_CAN_CAST incorrectly returns true: card_pit_fight checks its two target definitions independently and permits the same creature to satisfy both. Actual casting excludes the first chosen target, so its permission check disagrees with target selection. Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.

Behavior.Unmake_ExileGreenCreature.reason: Oracle cost is three white/black hybrid mana. Selecting BBB should reduce black mana from 10 to 7 and leave white at 10; the real cast instead reduces black to 4. The core put_card_on_stack path charges its printed BBB cost before the handler charges the selected hybrid payment again. Exile and ownership assertions pass. Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.
